scope.sourceUnitGranularity: This receipt closes the physical table/structured-list denominators for the 14 assigned queue IDs only. It does not certify each monster article body or all MM mechanics.

method.sourcePixelReview: Rendered the canonical PDF at 216 dpi and visually inspected one page image per tool result; used page images to establish visible folio, table heading, variant headings, field rows, table boundary and readable note/continuation cues. No OCR/lexical candidate was promoted to a source pass.
method.rowAndCellDefinition: For a creature stat matrix, one physical statistic label row is a row, and each printed variant value under that row is one variant-value cell. Cell values were not transcribed or verified. For Men distributions, one equipment/class/alignment band is one row, and each class/percentage field is counted as a cell. The Bandit example and Pilgrim class list are counted separately from table grids.
method.siteJoin: Compared source table types to the frozen actual 1,000-route detail snapshot, each record’s captured innerText/sourceRecord/publicSearch and the built dist/data.json. Static monsters.json locator records are reported separately and never treated as rendered app owners.
method.hashDefinitions: Snapshot sourceRecordSha256 is the capture’s stored canonical record hash. Render text hashes use UTF-8 innerText. Search object SHA-256 uses canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8); searchText hashes use UTF-8 searchText only.
method.numericScope: No profile table values were fully transcribed. Men percentage/count values are not exhaustively transcribed/recomputed. Row/axis/head counts and named qualifiers were established from pixels.

siteJoin.adjudication: No MM creature-profile card is present in the current runtime route snapshot. The static catalog contains locator/description records but no values from these multi-variant stat matrices. The full-profile matrices are excluded from the standalone rule/procedure comparison; this does not mark their profiles complete. The Men distributions and NPC-generation tables are operative procedures in scope and are absent from the current rendered/search owner set. Related PHB rule cards are explicitly non-equivalent.

checkedNegativeScope: The source pages listed in pageCoverage were visually inspected; the printed folio is visible in each image.
Within the 14 assigned source-unit IDs, table headings, variant/field axes, physical row counts, adjacent page boundaries and direct table notes listed above were reviewed.

Every one of the 1,000 captured routed site details was checked at the collection/book level for an MM owner: zero route records have an MM book source, and the runtime collection set has no monsters collection.
The locator-only monsters.json candidate records are not counted as rendered owners; they do not prove numeric profile table values are present.
unassessed: The numeric cells and all per-cell prose/number values in the 14 source matrices were not fully transcribed or independently recalculated.
The Men-section narrative profession procedures were screened to support table-boundary/qualifier review but were not exhaustively atomized into a full clause denominator.
No claim of whole-MM page coverage or complete MM source-unit coverage is made.
